description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -  Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division,  Kandy District - Cad. Map. No. 320552 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' identities, property rights, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
